note: Calloway County KY (FIPS 21035) parcels are not published as a public queryable service. The county PVA (ccpva.org) points to the Schneider qPublic web viewer, which exposes no public REST endpoint (403 / Cloudflare on access). The Kentucky state server kygisserver.ky.gov lists parcel services only for Webster County, none for Calloway. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no Calloway parcel layer; the Calloway KY feature service requires a token. Only commercial paid vendors (Dynamo Spatial, Equator, ACRES, countygismaps) offer Calloway parcels as downloads.
